title: Cabinet Refinishing in Williston, FL | Kitchen Cabinets
description: Cabinet refinishing in Williston, FL with degreasing, primer, and sprayed waterborne urethane enamel. Update dated oak or builder cabinets without a remodel.
heroIntro: A smooth, hard-wearing finish on your existing cabinet boxes and doors. It is a practical alternative to tearing out a kitchen that still works.

questions: Is painting cabinets cheaper than replacing them?
What paint do you use on kitchen cabinets?
Can you paint oak cabinets without the grain showing?

sections.h2: Two kitchens we see a lot in Williston
body: The first is the older kitchen with solid oak or stained cabinets that are structurally fine but dark and dated. The second is the newer US-27 build-out with builder cabinets whose factory finish is already chipping at the pulls. Cabinet refinishing in Williston, FL solves both without demolition, countertop removal, or weeks without a kitchen.
If you are on the fence, our article on refinishing versus replacing cabinets walks through when each makes sense.

sections.h2: Why cabinets need a different system than walls
body: Cabinets get grabbed, bumped, splashed, and cleaned every day. Wall paint would mark and peel within months. We use waterborne urethane enamel, which cures hard and resists the grease and moisture of a working kitchen. It is the same class of coating we put on doors and railings.
Adhesion is the whole game. Kitchen grease is invisible but it will lift paint, so every surface is degreased before anything else happens.

bullets: Degrease boxes, doors, and drawer fronts
Scuff-sand the existing finish for mechanical grip
Fill dings and, if wanted, fill the open oak grain
Spray two coats of urethane enamel for a smooth, brush-free finish

sections.h2: Keeping the kitchen usable during the project
body: Countertops, backsplash, floors, and appliances are masked before any sanding starts, and the work area is closed off from the rest of the house. Boxes are finished in place. Doors and drawer fronts are sprayed so the surface comes out smooth with no brush marks. The schedule for each stage is written into the estimate, so you know when the kitchen will be fully back in service.
Labelled touch-up paint is left with you at the end, which makes small chips easy to fix years from now. Other projects we handle across town are listed on our Williston painting contractor page.

sections.h2: Color choices for a refinished kitchen
body: We can match a color from a chip, an existing cabinet door, or a leftover can, and we make full-size drawdowns so you can judge it under your kitchen lighting. For oak specifically, our guide to painting oak cabinets explains how grain affects the final look.
Learn more about the full cabinet painting and refinishing service, or pair this project with interior painting in Williston so the walls and cabinets are finished together.

faqs.q: Will refinished cabinets hold up in a busy Williston kitchen?
faqs.a: With proper degreasing, sanding, a bonding primer, and waterborne urethane enamel, they are built for daily use. The surface cures hard and wipes clean.

faqs.q: Can you paint over stained oak cabinets?
faqs.a: Yes. Oak needs thorough cleaning and priming, and we can discuss filling the grain if you want a smoother look.

faqs.q: How do I know the final color will look right?
faqs.a: We make full-size drawdowns of the color so you can see it in your own kitchen light before we spray anything.

faqs.q: Do you paint bathroom vanities and built-ins too?
faqs.a: Yes. Vanities, built-in shelving, and interior doors can be included and finished with the same urethane enamel as the kitchen.
